abstract: PURPOSE: To review our experience in the management of malignant transformation of teratoma (MTT). MATERIALS AND METHODS: Nine patients with MTT were identified from January 1980 to August 2005, with all pathological specimens re-reviewed by a single genitourinary pathologist. RESULTS: Two patients presented with clinical stage I disease in which malignant transformation occurred within the primary testis tumor (rhabdomyosarcoma in 1 and adenocarcinoma in 1). These patients underwent a primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND). No viable tumor was identified in the specimen, and both patients were alive without disease at 16 months follow-up. Of the remaining 7 patients, the clinical stages were IIA (N = 1), IIB (N = 3), and III (N = 3), and all were treated with chemotherapy followed by RPLND. The MTT histology of these RPLND specimens consisted of adenocarcinoma (N = 3), rhabdomyosarcoma (N = 2), angiosarcoma (N = 1), and astrocytoma (N = 1). Following preoperative chemotherapy, a significant radiologic response (defined as more than a 25% reduction in maximum tumor circumferential diameter) was demonstrated in 1 patient, and normalization of serum tumor markers was demonstrated in 6. At a mean follow-up of 5 years, 3 of these 7 patients were alive with no evidence of disease, 1 had persistent disease, and 3 had died of disease, and their median disease-specific survival duration was 4.6 years. CONCLUSIONS: In our experience, MTT is significantly resistant to current chemotherapeutic regimens, as demonstrated by its poor radiologic response to treatment. Alternative therapeutic strategies targeted to MTT are thus needed.
abstract_ja:
目的：精巣奇形腫の悪性転化(MTT)の管理について経験をまとめること。
材料と方法：1980年1月から2005年8月までにMTTと診断された9例を同定し、すべての病理標本を泌尿生殖器病理医1名が再検討した。
結果：臨床病期Iの2例では、精巣原発腫瘍内でMTTが生じていた(横紋筋肉腫1例、腺癌1例)。これらの患者は初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた。切除検体に生存腫瘍は認められず、両患者とも16か月のフォローアップで無病生存していた。残り7例の病期はIIA(1例)、IIB(3例)、III(3例)であり、すべて化学療法の後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた。これらの後腹膜リンパ節郭清標本のMTT組織型は、腺癌(3例)、横紋筋肉腫(2例)、血管肉腫(1例)、星細胞腫(1例)であった。術前化学療法後、1例で有意な画像学的奏効(最大腫瘍周径の25%以上の縮小と定義)が認められ、6例で腫瘍マーカーの正常化が認められた。平均5年のフォローアップでは、7例中3例が無病生存、1例が持続性病変、3例が原病死し、原病特異的生存期間の中央値は4.6年であった。
結論：本施設の経験では、MTTは現行の化学療法レジメンに対して著明に抵抗性であり、画像学的奏効が乏しいことがその根拠となる。MTTを標的とした代替治療戦略が必要である。
